title: Expression cloning of membrane proteins in _Xenopus_ oocytes
protocol: Anesthetize a Xenopus frog for 15-30 minutes in ethyl m-aminobenzoate solution.
Place the anesthetized frog on crushed ice covered with wet tissue paper.
Make a small incision of about 1 cm length in the upper skin and a 0.5 cm cut in the inner skin and muscular layer.
Remove small clumps of oocytes using forceps, usually 500-1500 oocytes.
Treat the oocytes twice for 90 minutes each with collagenase A or D solution to remove follicular layers.
Rotate a tube containing collagenase solution and cut ovarian lobe clusters at low speed (20 rpm) in the dark at 18°C for 90 minutes.
Replace the collagenase-ORII solution and continue rotating the oocytes for another 90 minutes.
Wash the oocytes thoroughly five times with ORII solution.
Wash the oocytes thoroughly five more times with modified Barth's solution.
Sort the oocytes for morphologically intact, healthy stage V-VI oocytes.
Maintain the sorted oocytes in MBS at 18°C in the dark.
Inject healthy stage V-VI oocytes with either 50 nl water or mRNA.
Keep injected oocytes at 18°C in MBS solution for 1 to 7 days.
Change MBS solution every 1-2 days during incubation period.
Wash oocytes for 1-2 minutes in solution A.
Replace washing solution with 100 μl of solution A containing substrate and radiotracer at specified concentrations.
Incubate oocytes in water bath at 25°C for 1 to 60 minutes.
Remove uptake solution after incubation period.
Wash oocytes three times with ice cold stop solution.
Place each oocyte into a separate scintillation vial.
Dissolve oocytes in 200 μl of 1% SDS and shake vigorously for 45 minutes at room temperature.
When the oocytes have completely dissolved, supplement them with 2 ml scintillation fluid.
Measure isotopic uptake using liquid scintillation spectrometry, normally counted for 2 min per vial.

Construct a directional cDNA library using functionally positive unfractionated or size-fractionated mRNA as starting material and following the manufacturer's protocol (in this case the SuperScript plasmid system with pSPORT-1 vector).
Subdivide the total library into pools of 1,000 colonies and plate them onto 9 cm Luria Broth plates containing ampicillin at 100 μg/ml.
Make two replicas of the colonies onto nitrocellulose or nylon filters when colonies are visible (1 mm diameter) and place them on top of LB plates for about 6 hours.
Keep one filter as a master plate on an agar/glycerol plate, sealed with parafilm at -80°C.
Submerge the second replica into 10 ml Luria Broth containing ampicillin at 100 μg/ml and grow overnight at 37°C with shaking (300 rpm).
Centrifuge the cells for 1 minute to pellet them.
Isolate plasmids using an alkaline lysis method.
Digest approximately 1-2 μg of plasmid with NotI restriction enzyme.
Run an aliquot through an agarose gel to check digestion completeness.
Extract the rest twice with a mixture of 0.1 M Tris pH 8 saturated phenol: chloroform: isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1).
Precipitate the solution with 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 2.5 volumes of cold 100% ethanol at -20°C for 2 hours.
Dissolve plasmids in 10 μl of water.
Use the dissolved plasmid for in vitro transcription with T7 RNA polymerase.
Incubate the entire 10 μl (approximately 1 μg) of linearized plasmid DNA with a 40 μl transcription mixture at 37°C for 1 hour.
Add 50 units of RNAase inhibitor and 10 units of DNAase I, RNAase free, to the samples.
Incubate the samples with added inhibitors and enzymes at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Extract the samples twice with phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1).
Precipitate the samples by adding one volume of ammonium acetate 5 M and 2.5 volumes of ethanol to remove free nucleotides.
Pass samples through RNase-free Sephadex G-50 Quick Spin columns to remove free nucleotides.
Precipitate the samples at -80°C for at least 3 hours.
Centrifuge the precipitated samples for 45 min at 4°C.
Rinse pellets with 70% ethanol and vacuum dry for 5 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 15 μl of water.
Measure RNA concentration spectrophotometrically at OD260 using 1 μl of resuspended sample.
Run 1-2 μl through a 1% agarose formaldehyde RNA gel to check transcript integrity.
Use the remaining RNA for injection into oocytes.
Incubate injected oocytes for 1-6 days post-injection before measuring protein transport assay.
